description: Structure of a Slack message as returned by the Slack MCP server

fields.user: Slack user ID of the sender (e.g. U0123456)
fields.ts: Timestamp string used as message ID (e.g. 1713400000.000100)
fields.channel: Channel ID where the message was posted (e.g. C0123456)
fields.thread_ts: Timestamp of the parent message if this is a reply (null if top-level)
fields.reactions: List of emoji reactions on the message
fields.permalink: Full Slack URL to this message

notes: thread_ts is null for top-level messages
Use ts as thread_ts when replying to a top-level message
user is an ID — use slack_get_user_info to resolve to a name
